description: This file contains a Java class 'TimestampOrderNumberGenerator' that implements the 'OrderNumberGenerator' interface. It provides a method to generate or retrieve an order number, primarily used for testing purposes, based on a timestamp or a context attribute.

classes.name: TimestampOrderNumberGenerator
classes.description: A generator for order numbers used mainly in testing, either retrieving a set value from the context or generating a timestamp-based value with a prefix.

methods.name: getNewOrderNumber
methods.description: Returns a new order number either from the provided OrderContext attribute or by creating a timestamp-based string with a predefined prefix.
